description: Completed-action no-reversal (AV-05's dual): a protected action legitimately completed before revocation must NOT be reversed after the revocation — exercises the INV-04 'no reversal of completed actions' boundary rather than merely asserting it.

rule.name: INV-04_no_reversal_completed
rule.description: A revocation invalidates unexercised derived authority but does not reverse actions that legitimately completed before it

action.reason: action was unexercised at revocation time and must not proceed (INV-04)
